text.p: Romania coach Anghel Iordanescu has been forced to name a new-look midfield in his squad for Wednesday's World Cup group eight qualifier against Macedonia.
Two regulars -- skipper Gheorghe Hagi and Dorinel Munteanu -- are suspended while a third, Ionut Lupescu, is refusing to play.
"I called up young midfielders Denis Serban and Gabi Popescu to replace the veterans," Iordanescu said.
"Serban played brilliantly for Steaua in the European Cup preliminary round against Paris St. Germain on Wednesday. He cannot miss the game against Macedonia."
Borussia Moenchengladbach's Lupescu made himself unavailable after being upset at being left on the bench when Romania beat Lithuania 1-0 in March.
Fifteen of the 20-man squad play overseas, including five in Turkey.

Romania lead group eight with a maximum 18 points from six games, having scored 20 goals without conceding any. Macedonia are second with 13 from seven and victory for Romania would almost certainly guarantee them a place in the 1998 finals.
Goalkeepers - Bogdan Stelea (Salamanca, Spain), Dan Stingaciu (Kocaelispor, Turkey)

Defenders - Dan Petrescu (Chelsea, England), Anton Dobos (AEK Athens, Greece), Daniel Prodan (Atletico Madrid, Spain), Tibor Selymess (Anderlecht, Belgium), Liviu Ciobotariu (National Bucharest), Laurentiu Reghecampf (Steaua Bucharest), Marius Baciu (Steaua Bucharest), Dan Potocianu (Servette, Switzerland)

Midfielders - Iulian Filipescu (Galatasaray, Turkey), Gheorghe Popescu (Galatasaray), Constantin Galca (Espanyol, Spain), Ilie Dumitrescu (Atlante Ciudad de Mexico), Denis Serban (Steaua Bucharest), Gabi Popescu (Universitatea Craiova)
Forwards - Adrian Ilie (Galatasaray), Sabin Ilie (Fenerbahce, Turkey), Gheorghe Craioveanu (Real Sociedad, Spain), Viorel Moldovan (Grasshoppers, Switzerland)
